entry.title: New: Resolution 384 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE OFFICE OF HOUSING AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT TO AWARD FOUR GRANTS FOR PROGRAMS ADDRESSING AFFORDABLE HOUSING

Allows for grant awards to Hoʻomalu at Waikoloa LP ($3,000,000) for the development of affordable multi-family housing, Housing and Land Enterprise of Hawaiʻi County ($300,000) for the development of affordable single-family housing, Hawaiian Community Assets Inc ($4,100,000) for the acquisition of property, and Hawaiʻi Community Lending Inc ($790,100) for financial assistance for homeownership through deferred-payment loans.

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 384-25 & FC-108 - 12/03/25
